profile.measurement: Emulated CPU-timer elapsed time; not CPU utilization or host CPU time
limitations: Ares timing model; original N64 and M64 hardware validation remains pending.
Slot maxima are worst observed per-frame totals and must not be added together.
Submission scopes include internal queue stalls; this does not time RDP/GPU execution.
Audio callback time is attributed exclusively; other interrupts remain in the interrupted scope.
Profiling and enabled debug display add overhead. Incomplete trailing records are excluded.

elapsed.quantile_method: nearest rank of every exact CP0-tick sample

work.quantile_method: nearest rank of every exact CP0-tick sample

workload.geometry_evidence: RSP model bounds candidates and pre-clip triangle submission; full-body coverage unavailable

checks.name: steady_window
checks.detail: 3 warmup windows excluded; 30 complete windows, 30.087s measured; minimum 30s

checks.name: complete_frame_distributions
checks.detail: Every elapsed/work sample must be present; bounded-buffer overflow cannot pass

checks.name: 16.667ms_work_budget
checks.detail: All measured frames <=1000/60ms excluding display-buffer wait; includes normal audio, logging and queue stalls

checks.name: native_vi_presentation
checks.detail: One new framebuffer per native NTSC VI, zero repeated scans, no callback gap >1.5 VI periods; native refresh is reported precisely

checks.name: both_guards_drawn_every_frame
checks.detail: Every frame: two posed guard submissions; active attention head overlays are reported in 0..2 (quiet patrol may be zero); RSP model bounds candidates and pre-clip triangle submission; full-body coverage unavailable; image review separately proves appearance

checks.name: ordinary_live_workload
checks.detail: Normal gameplay and audio remain active; no capture/replay/terminal/error state

checks.name: authored_camera
checks.detail: One ordinary launch at authored two-guards preset

checks.name: independent_live_actors
checks.detail: Patrol advances along authored route while sentry holds its post during measured interval

checks.name: actual_visible_guard_images
checks.detail: Separately reviewed source-matched framebuffer images; geometry counters alone cannot satisfy this gate

checks.name: ordinary_rom_provenance
checks.detail: Existing-log analysis alone is diagnostic; a measured ROM must match its ordinary build manifest

rsp_lighting.scope: Nested CPU elapsed excluding audio; independent report windows selected inside steady interval. Do not add to parent slots.

animation_profile.scope: Nested CPU elapsed excluding audio; independent report windows selected inside steady interval. Do not add to parent slots.

limitations: Ares CP0/VI timing model, not original N64/M64 hardware validation or host monitor presentation.
VI_ORIGIN is observed once per VI before libdragon updates it, so evidence has one-field latency.
Work excludes waiting for a free display buffer; actual VI-origin changes separately gate graphics throughput.
Exact timing samples and logging add overhead; there are no capture dumps or forced graphics waits in the measured loop.
This verifies the authored two-guard camera/route, not crowded combat or worst-case audio.
Active procedural head attention is counted; quiet patrol/sentry can report zero and does not benchmark alerted head tracking.
